# Tamizh Investor Website Instructions

This repository is for a GitHub Pages website for tamizhinvestor.in.

## Core Principles
- Build with static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript whenever possible.
- Keep the site lightweight, fast, and easy to maintain.
- Prefer simple, professional, trustworthy design over visual clutter.
- Use Tamil as the primary language for all user-facing content.
- Write polished, natural Tamil with clear structure and respectful tone.
- Use Tamil-friendly fonts such as Noto Sans Tamil, Lohit Tamil, or similar fallbacks.
- Make the website responsive and accessible for mobile and desktop.
- Keep navigation, typography, spacing, and call-to-action patterns consistent across pages.
- If Tailwind CSS is used, keep the setup lean and intentional.

## Content and UX Rules
- All new pages should feel professional, modern, and neat.
- Use clear headings, readable spacing, strong contrast, and simple layouts.
- Prefer semantic HTML and accessible markup.
- Maintain GitHub Pages compatibility and relative links.
- Update navigation and related pages whenever a new page is added.
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies or heavy client-side frameworks.
- Use local assets and optimized images where possible.

## Writing Style
- Prefer clear Tamil prose over literal English translations.
- Use proper Tamil punctuation and polished phrasing.
- Keep copy concise, useful, and trustworthy.
- Use English only where it is genuinely necessary for brand or technical terms.
